Too right it is night bids us adieu
Lest pesky moon something meddlesome brew
Even sound asleep she may slip us a drink
And into vortex visions we'll hapless sink
Sometimes we imbibe the potion gladly,
Other times we wake morose or madly
Scramble to reconstruct the riddle
Which serves to say we're but strings of the fiddle.
